data.name: Dilipsinh
data.gender_notes: Dilipsinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dilipsinh is derived from Sanskrit roots. Dili (दिलि) means 'Dharma' or 'righteousness'. Sinh (सिंह) means 'Lion'. This name represents the brave and just ruler, embodying the strength and courage of a lion and the wisdom and virtuousness of dharma. The name Dilipsinh carries the meaning “Dharma (righteousness) and Lion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dilipsinh usually hope their child will grow to embody dharma (righteousness) and lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength in righteousness and courage.
data.etymology: Dilipsinh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dharma (righteousness) and Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilipsinh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, this name is deeply rooted in ancient Indian philosophies. The name represents the inner strength of one's dharma, embodied in the fearless spirit of the lion – Sinh.
